rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the cancer disease.

example.english: They were recently diagnosed with cancer, and their family is very worried.
example.traditional: 佢最近確診癌症，屋企人都好擔心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 kok3 zan2 ngaam4 zing3 uk1 kei2 jan4 dou1 hou2 daam1 sam1

rows.note: Use this shorter form when the context already makes the disease clear, especially in casual speech.

example.english: His dad has cancer and still needs chemotherapy.
example.traditional: 佢爸爸有癌，仲要做化療。
example.jyutping: keoi5 baa4 baa1 jau5 ngaam4 zung6 jiu3 zou6 faa3 liu4
